role: The census delta between two committed census artifacts, typed with the closed vocabulary admitted_identity | retired_identity | locator_rebind | judgment_change. It exists because a predecessor record's REQUIREMENT said a route had been retired while its own evidence correctly reported zero retirements: the route survived and only its locator re-bound. A typed delta makes the two mechanically impossible to confuse.

delta_vocabulary.admitted_identity: An identity in the after census and not in the before census. New surface, reviewed on its own terms.
delta_vocabulary.retired_identity: An identity in the before census and not in the after census. The ONLY kind that retires anything, and the only kind a bypass-diff retirement applies to.
delta_vocabulary.locator_rebind: The same identity found somewhere else. A locator field moved and NOTHING the census asserts about the identity changed. A rebind retires nothing and reduces nothing.
delta_vocabulary.judgment_change: The same identity carrying a changed assertion. A reviewable claim movement, never a formatting pass.

field_classification.rule: Every leaf field in either census is classified as locator, judgment, review_provenance, or identity BEFORE the delta is computed, and an unclassified field REFUSES the derivation. A delta that silently ignores a field it has not seen is not a delta.
field_classification.review_provenance_is_not_a_delta_kind: reviewed_as_of and its siblings neither locate an identity nor assert anything about it. Restamping them is counted separately and is deliberately outside the four-kind vocabulary, so a re-review date can never inflate a rebind or a retirement count.

precedence_rule: An identity whose judgment moved is counted as judgment_change even when its locator also moved, and the row records also_locator_rebound so the fact is not lost. Judgment is the stronger statement and is never hidden behind a rebind.
headline_finding: ZERO retirements occurred. The publication rebuild deleted a handler FUNCTION, not a route IDENTITY: the route identity survived and its handler, source file, symbol, and final-invoker locators re-bound onto the rebuilt handler. The predecessor requirement that demanded a retirement was wrong; the predecessor's own evidence, which reported zero, was right.

from.pre_effect_gates.ifc.note: No estate-wide label and destination closure is established at the final invoker.

to.pre_effect_gates.ifc.note: The symbols occur in the handler body; M0 does not claim final-invoker ordering.

from.pre_effect_gates.fence.note: No owner-derived active-writer fence is established at the final invoker.

to.pre_effect_gates.fence.note: The symbols occur in the handler body; M0 does not claim final-invoker ordering.

nonclaim: A typed delta says what moved between two census artifacts. It does not claim any final-invoker judgment is order-proven, does not claim the surfaces it names are correct, and closes nothing.
